issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: brick_stairs, red_wall_banner.

notes.detail: Capped at 1: L2 adds only props (two front banners, shutters, lanterns, carpets, a barrel, brick stairs at the chimney foot).
notes.purpose: The red banners over the door make it read as a guard house.
notes.roof: Steep, 1-block overhang, slab ridge and a dark oak eave row, but from the side it is one big flat spruce surface; no verge/barge trim or second tone.
notes.levels: The author's worry is right: from the iso and side views L2 is hard to tell from L1; only the two banners on the front gable stand out.

visual.summary: L1 plus red banners on the jetty, side-window shutters, lanterns and red carpets; a decoration pass, not a new feature.
problems: L2 adds no clearly visible new feature or job, only props: give it something that changes the silhouette, e.g. a covered porch/guard post with a bench at the door (z0..1), an outside stair to the loft, or a lookout window/balcony in the front gable.
Side walls still flat apart from the shutters (see L1).
Chimney still ends flush with the roof (x3 y7 z11).
Reachability: fine; only roof slopes are unreached, every room (mess room, bed loft) is reached.
